description: Where the parts of a flow graph are, for every engine that records, diffs or applies flow operations: its view state and its keyed lists. The stored flow JSON keeps its shape; this file only says how to address it. Paths are lists of object keys; '*' matches any key. The editor keeps a byte-identical copy.

view_state.description: Keys never recorded, diffed, merged or compared. Saves still store them. Every top-level key of a flow is view state, except the keys that 'flow.except' lists.

keyed_lists.description: Lists whose items are addressed by key instead of by index. 'key' is the path of the item's key inside the item (an integer is a list index there). Items of every list are selected with {"key": ...}, a table input row by its 'id'. Every keyed list is ordered by 'position', then key; the array order is not state. The engine owns both row keys, so no table input column may take the name of either.
